# Getting Support

Thanks for using react-debugger-extension. Here's where to go depending on what you need.

## Usage questions and discussion

Open a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/hoainho/react-debugger-extension/discussions).

Examples:

- "How do I use the Timeline tab on a Next.js app?"
- "What does the CLS score on the Memory tab actually mean?"
- "Is there a way to filter renders by component name?"
- "I'm not sure if my issue is a bug or expected behavior."

Discussions are the right place for open-ended help. The community can answer alongside the maintainer, which scales better than 1:1 issue threads.

## Bug reports

Open a [bug report issue](https://github.com/hoainho/react-debugger-extension/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

A bug is something that:

- Should work according to the documentation but doesn't
- Crashes the extension or the inspected page
- Returns wrong data (e.g., a render is recorded but missing from the Timeline)
- Has a regression from a previous version

Please fill out the issue form completely — Chrome version, extension version, React version, page URL, and reproduction steps. Without that, we usually cannot help.

## Feature requests

Open a [feature request issue](https://github.com/hoainho/react-debugger-extension/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).

Before opening, search [existing issues](https://github.com/hoainho/react-debugger-extension/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement) and [Discussions](https://github.com/hoainho/react-debugger-extension/discussions) for prior conversation on the idea.

## Security vulnerabilities

Do NOT open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for the private disclosure process.

## Things we cannot help with

- Debugging your React application itself (this is a tool to help YOU debug — we don't debug user apps)
- React DevTools or other extensions' behavior
- Browser bugs unrelated to our extension
- Closed-source / proprietary code we cannot reproduce against

## Response times

- Discussions: best effort, no SLA
- Bug reports: triaged within 7 days, fixed when feasible
- Security reports: acknowledged within 72 hours (see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md))
- PRs from contributors: reviewed within 7 days (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md))

This is a single-maintainer OSS project. Please be patient and kind.
